col.name: age_at_death
description: The age at which death occurred. Unit is a year.

col.name: age_at_diagnosis
description: The age of an individual at the time of initial pathologic diagnosis.

col.name: age_at_metastasis
description: Subject's age in years at initial metastasis of cancer

col.name: age_at_procurement
description: Subject's age in years at initial procurement of the sample

col.name: age_group
description: Age group classification: Newborn (< 1 month/28 days), Infant (>= 1 month & < 2 yrs), Child (>= 2 yrs & < 11 yrs), Adolescent (>= 11 yrs & < 18 yrs), Adult (>= 18 yrs & < 65 yrs), Elderly (>= 65 yrs)

col.name: ancestry
description: Population category defined using ancestry informative markers (AIMs) based on genetic/genomic data (children of HANCESTRO:0004)

col.name: ancestry_details
description: A person's descent or lineage (more specific than 'ancestry'). Patient's population ancestry information, inclusive of values relating to racial and ethnic groups

col.name: body_site
description: Named locations of or within the body. The anatomical location(s) affected by the patient's disease/condition/cancer, often the site from which the sample was derived

col.name: cancer_type
description: A type(s) of cancer (relevant to the sample) which the patient has been diagnosed with

col.name: cancer_type_detailed
description: Detailed information which elaborates on the corresponding curated_cancer_type value

col.name: country
description: Country where subject lives and/or data was collected

col.name: curation_id
description: Unique identifier

col.name: disease_metastatic_site
description: NA

col.name: disease_metastasis
description: Indicates if the sample is derived from a metastatic lesion

col.name: disease_type
description: Any abnormal condition of the body or mind that causes discomfort, dysfunction, or distress to the person affected or those in contact with the person. The disease(s) (relevant to the sample) which the patient has been diagnosed with

col.name: histological_subtype
description: NA

col.name: location
description: Location (more specific than 'country') where subject lives and/or data was collected

col.name: molecular_subtype
description: NA

col.name: oncotree_code
description: A unique identifier assigned to a specific cancer type within the open-source OncoTree classification system.

col.name: patientId
description: Subject identifier

col.name: sample_count
description: The number of samples belong to a given study/dataset

col.name: sample_type
description: Indicates if the sample is derived from a metastatic lesion
allowedvalues: Primary Neoplasm;Metastatic Neoplasm;Recurrent Neoplasm;Neoplasm;Benigh Neoplasm;Locally Recurrent Disease;Clinical Relapse;Distant Metastasis

col.name: sampleId
description: Sample identifier

col.name: sex
description: Biological sex of the subject as reported or inferred by sex-specific biological traits

col.name: smoker
description: Tobacco smoking behavior.  Assign `Non-smoker (finding)` only when the past smoking behavior information is unavailable.

col.name: specimen_type
description: The type of a material sample taken from a biological entity for testing, diagnostic, propagation, treatment or research purposes. This includes particular types of cellular molecules, cells, tissues, organs, body fluids, embryos, and body excretory substances. Origin of the specimen, including source of the cells, primary/metastatic/recurrent status, and anatomical location of derivation

col.name: study_design
description: A plan detailing how a study will be performed in order to represent the phenomenon under examination, to answer the research questions that have been asked, and defining the methods of data analysis. Study design is driven by research hypothesis being posed, study subject/population/sample available, logistics/resources: technology, support, networking, collaborative support, etc.

col.name: studyId
description: Dataset name

col.name: target_condition
description: The primary phenotype/condition of interest in the study from which the sample is derived

col.name: treatment_dose
description: A quantity of an agent (such as substance or energy) administered, taken, or absorbed at one time. Individual dose amount

col.name: treatment_duration
description: The length of time a treatment session lasts. A session is defined as the period of time between when the patient enters the treatment room and when they leave it. Overall duration of treatment

col.name: treatment_end
description: Treatment end date/time

col.name: treatment_frequency
description: The number of times a substance is administered within a specific time period. Frequency of treatment administration

col.name: treatment_group
description: A study population that receives an intervention(s) within a trial. This could include the investigational product(s) or a comparator (e.g., placebo or an approved intervention).

col.name: treatment_name
description: The literal identifier of a therapy. Specific name of drug/medication/treatment/surgical procedure

col.name: treatment_notes
description: miscellaneous treatment information that does not fit into the other categories

col.name: treatment_number
description: number of times individual treatment was administered; can be number of doses/cycles/lines

col.name: treatment_reason
description: stated purpose/goal of treatment; can be a specific treatment phase

col.name: treatment_start
description: Treatment start date/time

col.name: treatment_status
description: Information on treatment modifications or scheduling with respect to other treatments

col.name: treatment_type
description: Broad treatment category

col.name: tumor_staging_ajcc
description: American Joint Committee on Cancer (tumor staging) (SNOMED:258236004). A system to describe the amount and spread of cancer in a patient's body

col.name: tumor_staging_tnm
description: Tumor-node-metastasis (TNM) tumor staging system (tumor staging) (SNOMED:254293002).A system to describe the amount and spread of cancer in a patient's body

col.name: vital_status
description: Indicates whether a person is alive or deceased at a specific point in time.
